dataset_name: ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003
provider: NASA / METI / ASTER Science Team / LP DAAC
processing_step: Merged six adjacent ASTER tiles; reprojected to EPSG:32628; bilinearly resampled to a 30 m metric grid; evaluated 80 km region with 40 km windows and 10 km stride; calculated differential slope signatures at 240, 480, 960, 1920 and 3840 m baselines.
coverage_and_resolution: 80 km x 80 km region centered at 65.03 N, 16.75 W; 30 m output grid; source tiles at 1 arc-second posting.
quality_flags: All six source tiles opened as valid GeoTIFF with EPSG:4326 and full valid-cell coverage.
No water cells were masked in the extracted region using the 0.5 m threshold.
Terrain-only result; climate and geology were not included.
Not a landing-site safety assessment and not a final global ranking.

lunar_south_pole_lola.interpretation: Low terrain similarity; Askja is substantially less rugged than the lunar south-polar target in the matched slope profile.

mars_jezero_mola.interpretation: High terrain-profile similarity only; this does not establish geological, climatic, atmospheric or operational equivalence.
